item.title: October Lantern 0.6.15
item.description:
Add images to Ask Lantern on Windows

  • Paste a screenshot or image (Ctrl+V), drop one on the box, or pick with the paperclip. Up to 6 on a message, the same as on the Mac.
  • Lantern's answer sees the first image. An agent it starts gets them all, and replies to a running agent include them too.

Also

  • On Windows, if one saved chat can't be read, Lantern skips just that one instead of losing the rest.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
